page.layout: One column of index entries under the heading INDEX. Entries run down the page; the letter D. stands on its own line with 131 at the right. No margins, no running head. The hyphenated word "scriptori-" is completed by "bus" at the lower right.

page.notes: The Greek word opening the entry beginning "Διαθήκη" is hard to read and is marked [?]. The "131." on the D. line is treated as part of that line, not as a head page number, since no page number is printed at the head or foot. The word "bus" at the lower right completes "scriptori-" and is given as the catchword. The entry "Cunæi error de Melchised." is read as printed, with "Melchised." in the scan.
